sentences: Online local learning predicts labels for small groups of items while competing with a single global labeling of the whole universe.
Finding the globally best explanation can be computationally hard, even when each individual prediction concerns only a few variables.
The source asks how generally efficient local prediction can avoid that global inference difficulty.
Its model reveals a subset on each round and evaluates the learner's proposed labeling through a local payoff.
A sharp regret guarantee would show when coherent performance can be achieved through local decisions without explicitly recovering the latent global structure.
